Buy TokenTrim Pro License

TokenTrim Pro gives you a hosted dashboard, weekly budget alerts, and Slack totals. Install the free toolkit or upgrade to Pro for a full‑featured, cost‑saving experience.

How it works for a single developer

  1. Clone the repo or install the plugin.
  2. Run tokentrim to trim Claude Code output and read files in ranges.
  3. Use the replay command to see your savings.
  4. Upgrade to Pro: the hosted dashboard appears on any device, and you get a Monday digest and a weekly budget alert at 80%.

What you get / what it costs

  • Free: all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, cold‑cache alert.
  • Pro: $49 lifetime (first 500 buyers) or $9/month.
  • Pro adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, weekly budget alert at 80%, Slack totals, and support for up to 3 machines.

FAQ

Question? How much can I save with TokenTrim? Answer: On 135 real conversations, history re‑read was cut by 75%, limits last 4.0x longer, and billed cost fell roughly 55‑70%. Shrinking tool output alone saved 6.9%.

Question? Do I need a special environment? Answer: TokenTrim requires Python 3.9 or newer and works on macOS and Linux. Nothing leaves your machine by default.

Question? Can I use it on multiple devices? Answer: Yes, Pro supports up to 3 machines and offers a hosted dashboard viewable on any device.
